description: Complete guide to Vung Tau, Ba Ria-Vung Tau: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Vung Tau is a city in Ba Ria-Vung Tau with a population of 450,000. A coastal city near Ho Chi Minh City known for its beaches, oil industry, and as a weekend getaway destination, offering a more relaxed pace than the big city. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
